{{InfoboxContainer|[[Story Mode|Story]] Missions|*{{Money|200}} on death ([[Surface Tension]] & [[Lights Out]])}} |hidden = No |ghost = No |fly = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) |legacy_base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 |legacy_speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |legacy_defense = {{Defense}}20% |legacy_cash = {{Money|5}} on death |legacy_hidden = No |legacy_ghost = No |legacy_fly = No |legacy_lead = No |legacy_immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Break}}''' - Upon death, the '''Breaker3''' spawns a [[Breaker2]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Breaker3''' is an enemy that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], [[Challenge Trials]] and [[PVP]] modes. In most cases, it does not appear naturally, and is instead spawned by the [[Breaker4]]. It has a low amount of health, average speed and 20% defense. Upon death, it will spawn one [[Breaker2]]. The [[Breaker2]] has less health and no defense, but is faster and can spawn one [[Breaker]] upon death. Because three of them spawn from the [[Breaker4]] upon death, they will create huge hordes of enemies, which can easily overwhelm unprepared players. The '''Breaker3''' was replaced by the [[Png Bot3]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Breaker3''' is a humanoid with a red torso and legs that have a rhombus pattern design of varying sizes and the colors yellow, fiery orange and dark red. Its arms and head are made out of light orange construction paper, with the front and back faces of each part being separate halves held together by small strips of tape. It has a small green humanoid on its chest that represents the [[Breaker2]]. If spawned from the [[Breaker4]], the '''Breaker3''' jumps up with its left arm pointed upwards before falling to the ground. It plays a squeaking sound and emits small waves and red confetti particles on death. |Legacy |The legacy '''Breaker3''' has a pastel light orange skin color. It has a red torso and legs with a plaid stitch mark pattern on them. It has a green humanoid on its torso, representing the [[Breaker2]]. It plays a crumbling sound on death. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Breaker3''' spawns one [[Breaker2]] upon death. As three '''Breaker3s''' spawn from the [[Breaker4]], this can create large hordes of Breakers, which can make the '''Breaker3''' quite a dangerous enemy. **Since their specialty is creating hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Assassin]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] or the [[Mercenary Base]]'s [[Grenadier]]s can be very effective against them. **Setting your towers to ''strong'' targeting can help against the '''Breaker3''' as doing so avoids the [[Breaker2]] and [[Breaker]]'s invulnerability frames. **High DPS towers are also recommended, supported by the [[DJ Booth]], [[Medic]] and [[Commander]]. *Be aware that you do not earn any cash from damaging the '''Breaker3''' or any enemies it spawns in most modes, as it does not appear naturally. [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and [[Badlands II]] are the exception to this, where the '''Breaker3''' does spawn naturally and give you cash upon killing them. *The enemies that spawn from the '''Breaker3''' do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Spawning |- |[[File:BreakerJump.ogg]] |When the '''Breaker3''' spawns |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:BreakerDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Breaker3''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} Breaker3Walk.gif|Current walk animation (2 August 2024 – Present) Breaker4death.gif|Current spawning animation (2 August 2024 – Present) Breaker3StunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Legacy)}} Legacybreaker3walk.gif|Current walk animation (30 September 2022 – Present) LegacyBreaker3StunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation (30 September 2022 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1Breaker3.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Breaker3.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseBreaker3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacyBreaker3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} GenericThumbnail173.png|'''Breaker3''' on the game thumbnail. v2.2.0GenericThumbnail14.png|'''Breaker3''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} October10Icon.png|'''Breaker3''' on the game icon. LegacyBreaker3IconIG.png|Legacy '''Breaker3''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Breaker3's''' animation when spawning from a [[Breaker4]] is a reference to [[Mariowiki:Mario|Mario]] from the ''Super Mario Bros'' franchise. *The '''Breaker3''' has the most gamemode appearances, appearing in twelve gamemodes total, alongside the [[Breaker]], [[Breaker2]], and [[Breaker4]]. *The functionality of this enemy is very similar to the [[Solar Shard]], [[Lunar Shard]] and [[Dust]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. **The appearance of this enemy is similar to the [[Uber Mystery]], a removed enemy. *The legacy '''Breaker3''', along the [[Breaker]], [[Breaker2]]and [[Breaker4]], will turn into a opaque recolored version of itself when turned into a unit by the [[Hacker]]. *While the Legacy version of the '''Breaker3''' can drop a [[Logbooks|Logbook]], getting it will only give the player the modern '''Breaker3''' in the [[Index]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''30 September 2022''' -
